description: This PHP script initializes and manages scheduled cron tasks within the vtiger CRM system. It includes setup, permission checks, fetching active cron jobs, executing them, error handling, and logging information, primarily for running scheduled background jobs.

classes.name: Vtiger_Cron
classes.description: Class responsible for defining individual cron job instances and managing their execution status, including checking if they are runnable, marking start/end, and handling timeouts.

methods.name: setBulkMode
methods.description: Sets the cron task to operate in bulk mode for efficient execution.

methods.name: isRunnable
methods.description: Determines if the cron task is ready to run based on scheduling conditions.

methods.name: hadTimedout
methods.description: Checks if the cron task previously timed out and needs restarting.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the cron task.

methods.name: markRunning
methods.description: Marks the cron task as currently running.

methods.name: getHandlerFile
methods.description: Returns the file path of the script that performs the cron task.

methods.name: markFinished
methods.description: Marks the cron task as completed.
